transition_reason: The G5 repository prerequisite is already merged and the current owner-VPS capability preflight executed. The booted-systemd WP1202 product discriminator therefore did not execute. This is infrastructure/authorization evidence, not a product negative, and it must not trigger product-code mutation, duplicate dispatch, scope inflation, or fallback to the physical workstation.
next_exact_action: Repair only the owner-VPS S2 privilege boundary so claylab can invoke the existing guarded nspawn authority with noninteractive root-equivalent authorization. Re-run the capability preflight.
